meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 读取指定文件。纯文本会补上 frontmatter 并用标题、加粗、列表、代码块排版;已有 Markdown 会先询问优化、保留或只修排版。除只修排版外,输出「文件名-formatted.md」,并运行脚本修间距、引号。
howto.when: 当用户要求「格式化 Markdown」「美化文章」或改进文章排版,并给出待处理文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇纯文本格式化成规范 Markdown
美化这个 Markdown,加上标题和摘要,别改内容
say.note: 会先询问标题候选,再输出新文件

say.text: 只修排版和引号,不动原文结构
say.note: 选择排版修正模式时,直接处理原文件,不另存副本

howto.what_en: Reads a text file. Plain text becomes markdown with frontmatter and formatting; markdown input lets user choose optimize, keep, or typography-only. Saves to {filename}-formatted.md unless typography-only, then fixes spacing/quotes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to format markdown, beautify an article, or improve article layout, and provides a file to process.

say_en.text: Format this plain text as markdown.
Add a title and summary to this markdown, don't change the content.
say_en.note: Asks for title candidates first, then outputs a new file.

say_en.text: Fix only spacing and quotes, keep the original structure.
say_en.note: Typography-only mode edits the original file in place.
